Which Rows Hold a Decimal Rather Than a Percentage

Source: R/format_xlsx.R
ck_is_decimal_type.Rd

stat is a proportion for the proportion and combination analyses, so those rows take the percentage format. mean, median and ratio are numbers in the question's own units and take the plain number format - a ratio of 2.4 children per household displayed as a percentage reads as 240%.

Usage

ck_is_decimal_type(analysis_type)

Arguments

analysis_type

The analysis_type column, any case.

Value

A logical vector, TRUE where the row is a plain number.

Details

The rule lives here because it is applied in two places, the matrix layout and the blocks layout, and an analysis type added to one and not the other is formatted inconsistently depending on which layout was asked for.
